#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n, B;
    cin >> n >> B;
    vector<int> a(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        cin >> a[i];
    }
    int ce = 0, co = 0;
    vector<int> count;
    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
        if (a[i] % 2 == 0) {
            ce++;
        } else {
            co++;
        }
        if (co == ce) {
            count.push_back(abs(a[i] - a[i + 1]));
        }
    }
    std::sort(count.begin(), count.end());
    int sum = 0, cou = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < count.size(); i++) {
        sum += count[i];
        if (sum > B) {
            break;
        }
        cou++;
    }
    cout << cou << "\n";
    return 0;
}
